user_story: As a user, I want the forgot-password endpoint to require the email field so that incomplete requests are rejected.

positive.title: Forgot Password with Valid Email
steps: Prepare a valid request payload with an existing user's email.
Send the request to the forgot-password endpoint.
positive.expected_result: The system sends a password reset email to the user's email address.

negative.title: Forgot Password with Missing Email
steps: Prepare a request payload without the email field.
Send the request to the forgot-password endpoint.
negative.expected_result: The system returns a 400 Bad Request error indicating that the email field is required.

negative.title: Forgot Password with Invalid Email Format
steps: Prepare a request payload with an invalid email format (e.g., 'user@domain').
Send the request to the forgot-password endpoint.
negative.expected_result: The system returns a 400 Bad Request error indicating that the email format is invalid.

negative.title: Forgot Password with Non-existent Email
steps: Prepare a request payload with an email that does not exist in the system.
Send the request to the forgot-password endpoint.
negative.expected_result: The system returns a 200 OK status but does not send any email, handling the request gracefully without exposing existence of email.

edge.title: Forgot Password with Extremely Long Email Address
steps: Prepare a request payload with an email address at the maximum length allowed by the system.
Send the request to the forgot-password endpoint.
edge.expected_result: The system processes the request correctly and sends a password reset email if the email exists, or handles the request gracefully if not.

edge.title: Forgot Password with Email Containing Special Characters
steps: Prepare a request payload with an email containing special characters permitted by the email standards (e.g., 'user+test@domain.com').
Send the request to the forgot-password endpoint.
edge.expected_result: The system processes the request correctly and sends a password reset email if the email exists, or handles the request gracefully if not.
